root_cause: the installer outer checks used manifest authority, but its formal publisher deployment-preflight still applied mutable origin/main ancestry and runtime drift guards; the prior positive test bypassed that seam with a fake READY response
fix: add an explicit bounded manifest-authorized deployment-preflight mode, load and validate the canonical manifest in the public CLI, bind actor_root, actor_head, runtime_digest, and manifest_digest exactly, and keep normal callers on the existing origin/main guards
